sheet_name.description: The workbook sheet these settings are read from today, when there is one. It was required, which quietly made this descriptor a sheet mirror rather than a settings form: a provider with no workbook could not describe its equipment at all, and the read-only status was a consequence of that shape rather than a decision. The sibling table descriptors keep it required because they really are sheet mirrors.
